reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getBulkEditableCategories and reads activity with getSheetValue, but writes its own expense/income sign flip instead of sharing the one setNMonthAvg applies.

duplication.why: Only the small sign rule (negate for expense categories) is repeated inline; selection and write path are shared.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration/type and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with setZero/setAllCategoriesNMonthAvg; the inline sign rule is a second place to keep in sync with setNMonthAvg.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts setLastMonthSpending: `cat.is_income === 1 ? activity : -activity` restates setNMonthAvg's `if (is_income === 0) avg *= -1` in reversed form
